rows.whatWasWrong: participant-instructions.md stated, in two of its withheld reasons, that "Nothing in the committed record for this route establishes which of the two blocks the participant occupies", and production-field-map.json and reports/caption-evidence.json carried the same sentence. It was false, and it was false in a participant-facing document that the packet contradicted three sections later: filing-instructions.md already quoted destination.detail from the very record that answers it, the word "respondent" included, and quoted rules.fees and rules.service from the same node. The build read that record for the clerk's duties, the fee and the service rule and simultaneously told the participant the record was silent on the party role. The underlying cause is that NOTHING IN THE BUILDER EVER READ A RECORD: every sentence beginning "the committed record says" was a paraphrase typed into a string literal, and the silence claim was another one. A paraphrase cannot go stale loudly.
whatWasDone: The builder now loads data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/KY.memo.json, hashes it, and DERIVES the party role from participantInputs rather than stating it. All five readings are asserted by substring on every run and the build stops if any of them stops saying what it says. The caption-block mapping is keyed off the derived role, so if the record ever named the petitioner instead, the write would follow it.

first res / middle res / last res are bound to participant.first_name / middle_name / last_name -- three facts the map already declared in factMap and never used. The name is already decomposed on this route, so the legitimate objection that a single legal-name string cannot be split safely does not arise.

The PETITIONER block stays withheld, and its reason no longer claims a silence. It now says what is true: the record puts the participant in the RESPONDENT block, the packet has already written the name there, and the PETITIONER block names the other person in the case -- on this route the person who petitioned against the participant -- whose name this platform does not hold.

participant-instructions.md gained a 'Which side of the caption you are on' section quoting all five record nodes with the record's path and SHA-256, a 'What this packet has already filled in for you' section listing the prefills proved by ink in the canonical bytes, a 'What this motion does not reach' section carrying the record's two packet_instruction limitations verbatim, and a 'When this packet stops being the right tool' section carrying its four selfHelpStopConditions and its self_help_boundary verbatim and labelled as the record's own words.

reports/caption-evidence.json now records resolvedByTheRecord true with the five readings, the record digest, and the reason the other party's block is still withheld. approval-request.json's owner determination moves from ownerDeterminationRequested to ownerDeterminationsResolved, answered by the record rather than by this lane. build-findings.json carries the superseded finding rather than deleting it.
The product-wiring.json write was routed through the shared governance-preservation mechanism (see governanceState below).
